column1: # Detection bench — divergence-shaped PRAXIS scenarios. Frozen before the runs.
# Metric is DETECTION (diagnose the fault), NOT resolution. No fix, no verify.
# Columns (tab-separated):
#   scen         PRAXIS id
#   strength     strong | weak  (Cem's split)
#   deploy       recimage | setimage | scale0
#   target       deployment the fault lands on (== rci_service)
#   rec_tag      recimage: faulted recommendation image tag; setimage: the bad image; scale0: -
#   pdb_tag      matching neo4j-productdb variant, or NONE
#   neo4j_ep     recommendation's NEO4J_PRODUCT_DATABASE_ENDPOINT, or -
#   extra_env    extra recommendation env k=v;k=v, or -
#   rci_service  ground-truth faulty service (RCI target)
#   bootstrap    yes = fault fires at startup (pod never serves); no = serving-time fault
# Fault nature (RCR target, graded by grade-detect.sh):
#   401 field/contract mismatch (products_list vs proto products)      405/406 neo4j no-timeout deadlock/hang
#   407/408 neo4j deadlock-timeout    409/410 neo4j livelock (retry loop)
#   413/414 wrong DB host/label (master-neo4j-productdb, real=neo4j-productdb/primary)
#   415 bad config NUM_PRODUCTS>catalog -> list index OOB    416 bad config-db
#   20 product-catalog pointed at wrong image (app-image:latest, ImagePull fail)
#   32 ad scaled to replicas=0 (service silent)
scen
